annotation.evidence_span: The server MUST NOT send data on any other stream until the client’s SETTINGS frame has been received
annotation.interpretation_a: The server must wait for the *entire* client SETTINGS frame to be received before sending data on any stream.
annotation.interpretation_b: The server must wait for the *start* of the client SETTINGS frame to be received before sending data on any stream; it can begin sending data as the frame is being received.
annotation.justification: The word 'received' is ambiguous. Does it mean the complete frame has been received and processed, or merely that the first byte of the frame has been received?
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify whether the entire frame or just the beginning of the frame needs to be received before the server can send data.
